pieces.Text: You can harness the terrifying reputation of dragons to strike fear into the hearts of those you oppose. You've read or seen so much of dragons' tactics that you can mimic them with surprising accuracy and effectiveness. When you successfully use Intimidate to bully a creature, its change in attitude lasts for an additional 10 minutes. When you successfully use Intimidate to demoralize an opponent, it is shaken for 1 additional round.
